caption: The drawing depicts a stylized eagle with outstretched wings. The wings are colored yellow with brown outlines and details indicating feathers, spanning horizontally across the center of the image. The body of the eagle is not fully illustrated, but there is a shield attached where the eagle’s body would be. The shield is vertically oriented with a dark blue top section containing a single white star, and below this, red and white vertical stripes. The eagle stands on a brown, rock-like base with green and yellow patches. The overall composition is centered, with the eagle and base occupying the middle of a plain, light beige background. The head and feet of the eagle are faint and sketchy, not filled in with color or detail.
title: Stern Piece
